rv.q: If there's a do-not-miss musical thus far this year, 'Charlie and Lucy' is it.
Judging from the intensely approving reactions and loud laughter of the opening night audience, Lookingglass Theatre has another major hit on its hands.
I really can't recommend the show enough. The story, for the most part, is bouncy and fun with the right amount of something deeper infused in it.
Lucy and Charlie's Honeymoon will reel you in with its high-spirited Bonnie and Clyde mixed with Monty Python's wit that's a hilarious and enthralling play with intriguing grit.
The absurd premise disarms with charm and sneaks in topics of cultural relevance while your guard is down.
With us handily distracted, Lucy and Charlie made off with all our hearts.
It's a wide-ranging, often hilarious, attempt to satirize and in its own way, the Yee script certainly makes a definitive point or two.
The solidness of the production shows just how strong Lookingglass is in its ability to bring exciting new works to Chicago.
Lucy and Charlie's Honeymoon was a delightfully entertaining and hilarious theatrical treat that you do not want to miss.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically praise this world-premiere musical as an audacious, energetic romp featuring first-generation Asian American renegades on a crime spree, with standout performances and original country-western songs delivering laughs and heart.
